title: A Buy 1 Take 1 sale
summary: The promo applies by itself: the till says when one more is free, and the free item prints at its price less the promo.

steps.say: Scan one: the till says one more is free

steps.caption: One can in the cart: "B1T1 Sardines: add 1 more, free".
Two cans: one is free. The line shows "less B1T1 Sardines (1 free)" and the total shows Promos.
